_eligibility_text: - The applicant should meet any of the following conditions: 1. The applicant should be pursuing or have completed a Graduate or Postgraduate degree from a recognized university (national or international). 1. The applicant, if applying as a Graduate student, should have secured at least 75% marks in Class 12. 1. The applicant, if applying as a Postgraduate student, should have secured at least 60% marks in Graduation. 1.
